ALTER PROCEDURE DW.SP_DimCustomerNameURL
AS
BEGIN

Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/a3683b14-f298-4ae2-8106-f0b5a1d32e97/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/ccaeb1e4-6648-4558-8e69-43483960b143/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL
from dw.dimcustomer dc
where dc.customerid in (select distinct customerid from dw.dimcustomeraccount
                    where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'
                    and banksk = 1
                    and currentindicator = 1)
      and currentindicator = 1              
END
